At 80% battery health, Apple flags your phone as "significantly degraded" and notes that it is in need of service to function correctly and reliably. Around that time, Apple throttles your device performance to keep it alive on a charge. What this means is that 80% means your phone is in "hospice care" and less, you're dead.
